findings.title: Lifecycle calendar defects: one day dropped between cycles, index-based DTE, truncated final cycle at full premium, per-leg expiries ignored
evidence: strategy/backtest.py:548 day_idx = expiry_idx + 1 skips the spot move between expiry_idx and expiry_idx+1 in every cycle transition (Fable quantifies 23 dropped days, ~-12,985 USD/BTC understatement for long-BTC strategies)
strategy/backtest.py:408 expiry_idx = min(cycle_start_idx + dte_days, n_days-1): DTE is an array-index offset assuming perfectly contiguous daily bars; data gaps silently stretch cycles
final truncated cycle books a full 30-DTE premium (T = dte_days/365 at line 343) then settles after as little as 0 days
strike-ladder legs with dte 30/37/44 (definitions.py:302-337) are all priced and settled at the single 30-day cycle expiry; Leg.expiry_timestamp never consulted
findings.impact: Cumulative spot P&L excludes 23 daily moves whose sign is path-dependent (in the surviving window they sum to -12,985 USD/BTC, i.e. reported long-BTC P&L is OVERSTATED there); cycle windows drift from real venue expiries; ladder strategies are not actually laddered; premium of the final cycle is overstated.
findings.repair: Drive the cycle calendar from actual dates: cycle expiry = calendar date (entry + DTE days) mapped to the nearest available bar; no gap between consecutive cycles (next entry = expiry bar); price the final cycle with its true remaining T or exclude it; settle each option leg at its own expiry_timestamp.
findings.residual: Venue expiry conventions (Deribit 08:00 UTC Fridays) require D-3 resolution before exact venue calendars can be enforced; interim repair uses calendar-day arithmetic on observed bars.
